notice: All organizations, account facts, activity and results are synthetic. These are proposed GTM workflows, not deployed employer systems or measured company performance.
title: Turn an account hypothesis into a useful conversation.
intro: A proposed growth system for Sapien: keep financial and operational research evidence visible, give the BDR a precise discovery question and compare channels on qualified outcomes.
queueIntro: Separate public business signals from confirmed operational needs. An analyst’s hypothesis is not proof that a prospect has a particular financial problem.
workbenchIntro: Change the evidence level, operational question and ownership. Keep the BDR responsible for the conversation while the system prepares a traceable brief.
firstBuild: A vertical account brief with a clear next question
firstBody: Start with manufacturing and multi-location operations. Distinguish a public expansion signal from a confirmed reporting or margin-analysis problem, then hand off an owned research brief.

metricsTitle: Compare the channel and the cohort, not just volume.
metricsIntro: Synthetic channel spend and qualified-opportunity counts. A small event cohort and a broad outbound campaign have different selection effects.
metricsNotes: Account-to-qualified-opportunity conversion uses the original target-account cohort.
Spend includes the illustrative channel budget only. Include labor and full acquisition costs before calling any figure CAC.
Use consistent qualification and observation windows; do not rank channels solely by tiny sample differences.

experiments.name: Evidence-labeled account brief
experiments.hypothesis: A BDR can prepare better when a confirmed need is distinct from a hypothesis.
experiments.treatment: Evidence level, source and discovery question
experiments.primary: Held conversations with a confirmed business need
experiments.guardrail: False personalization and research correction rate
experiments.allocation: Assign matched accounts to one variant for a fixed observation window; review uncertainty before expansion.

experiments.name: Vertical-specific content
experiments.hypothesis: A clear operational question attracts more relevant discovery.
experiments.treatment: A concrete finance-analysis workflow and its limitations
experiments.guardrail: Audience mismatch and unsupported outcome claims
experiments.allocation: Assign matched accounts to one variant for a fixed observation window; review uncertainty before expansion.

roadmap.title: Make one vertical repeatable
roadmap.body: Agree on account identity, evidence labels, qualification and BDR ownership. Build a small reviewed research queue.

roadmap.title: Connect channels and pipeline
roadmap.body: Record channel cohorts, spend and meeting outcomes. Keep booked, held and qualified milestones separate.
roadmap.measure: Qualified opportunity rate and cost coverage

roadmap.title: Turn evidence into playbooks
roadmap.body: Compare experiments with founders and sales. Improve the best channel while documenting retries, source freshness and handoff exceptions.
roadmap.measure: Repeatable qualified pipeline and system reliability

aiApplication: At Sapien, I would use a research swarm to prepare manufacturing and multi-location account context, then validate the difference between a public signal and a confirmed business problem. The loop would measure rep acceptance and qualified conversations.
